messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly e2e (longseq) gate flipped to orange on commit 9a1b2c3.
p95 is ~420ms vs baseline ~300ms. failing job: longseq-nightly/runner-7. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/longseq/9a1b2c3

ci-bot: [AUTO] e2e-longseq-nightly #4321 failed perf-gate
p50=85ms p95=420ms p99=560ms
Regression detected: +120ms p95 over baseline. See artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4321/artifacts

ryan: on it — I'll queue a quick rerun. do we want full longseq or mixedseq variant?

maya: full-longseq (sequence=4096+, kv-cache enabled). this is the one that gates bandwidth-sensitive workloads.

sara: noted. infra FYI — runner-7 had intermittent host load spikes around 03:10 UTC yesterday. might be noisy. @devops-bot can you surface recent node events?

devops-bot: node runner-7 events (last 24h):
- 03:12 UTC: host load spike (avg 1m 5.2 -> 12.8 for 2m)
- 03:13 UTC: recovered
- GPU errors: none flagged by nvidia-smi
logs: https://infra.redwood.ai/nodes/runner-7/events

lin: if rerun goes green I can bisect. prefer bisect range: 9a1b2c3..a1b2c3d (last green -> first bad). please keep artifacts.

ryan: kicking rerun now.
Command: ```buildkite-agent pipeline upload && buildkite-agent annotate "rerun for perf-gate" --style info && buildkite-agent build 4321 --retry``` 
Rerun URL: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4323

ci-bot: Rerun started: e2e-longseq-nightly #4323 — ETA ~30m. Logs streaming: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4323/logs

maya: thanks. if #4323 passes, lin pls start bisect and include the mixedseq sanity run as a verification. if #4323 still orange, escalate to perf-oncall and mark priority:high.

ryan: will monitor. ping me for any manual rerun or to pin to a dedicated host. :eyes:

sara: adding a short note to the flaky-tests tracking thread so we remember runner-7 noise.

lin: ack. will stand by to bisect once rerun stable.
